integrationReview.approach: Restore the merged feature source, reapply the hidden spacer attribute and URL-parameter snapshot lint explanation, then format it. This avoids carrying obsolete manual controls through conflict resolution.

compiledEquivalence.normalization: Compile JS/TS with stable identifiers, coalesce adjacent string literals in React children arrays, remove comments. Allow only the intentional aria-hidden spacer attribute.

integrationReview.checks: Clean CI-style npm ci, format/lint/build including TypeScript, and production audit passed. Initial format of the long voice method chain required a second pass; final format check is clean.
